question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, which composition gave the highest equilibrium CO2 uptake at 298 K and about 1 bar, and how much did it adsorb?
rendered: According to the paper "Biochar loading modulates pore accessibility and CO2 adsorption in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids" (page 1), the composition BC-10 gave the highest equilibrium CO2 uptake at 298 K and a terminal equilibrium pressure of approximately 1 bar. The amount of CO2 adsorbed was 39.59 cm3 STP per g, which is equivalent to 1.77 mmol g−1.
